answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks through semantic proof-of-work. Entities register by publishing deterministic inference traces from evaluating complex prompts, such as parsing an intricate sonnet across an ocean of model weights. This forces an attacker to incur the verifiable cost of dedicated accelerator memory per active persona. However, viewing compute barriers as an absolute safeguard is a fable, because wealthy adversaries can rent massive GPU clusters to sustain clone swarms.
